svg.title: Ayala Triangle Gardens ground plan from OpenStreetMap (Phase 1 baseline)
svg.desc: North-up plan: Paseo de Roxas along the north, Ayala Avenue along the south-west, Makati Avenue along the east, with buildings, footways, steps, tunnels and numbered key places.
svg.text: 8 Steps down to Starbucks and mall
9 NE steps up to the towers
North up. Grid lines every 56 m. Tan footways, orange steps, dashed tunnels, blue water.
Coral: key places. Purple: other underpasses. Amber: placed from local knowledge (not in OSM).
Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), extract of 2026-10-06.
